summary: Install-time remote code execution via AES-decrypted URL fetch-and-eval in @jsimplify/errno
details: @jsimplify/errno declares an `install` lifecycle script that detaches a background `node index.js` on `npm install`. index.js AES-256-CBC-decrypts a hardcoded hex ciphertext (key + IV + ciphertext embedded in the source) to produce a URL, fetches that URL, and passes the response body to `eval`, executing attacker-controlled JavaScript on the installer's machine at install time. The destination URL is hidden behind AES decryption specifically to defeat static endpoint scanning. The package name, description, and author metadata (Rod Vagg / rvagg) impersonate the legitimate `errno` library, while the repository field points to an unrelated fork (`maxpsmith/node-errno`) and an unusual `bun` runtime dependency is declared.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
